name: omega
description: Open-source agent chat stack: streaming chat API, assistant-ui frontend, sandbox compute orchestrator, pi-harness agent runtime, and RAG service.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/chat-api build && bun run --cwd apps/controller build && bun run --cwd apps/chat-frontend build && bun run --cwd apps/rag-api/api build && bun run --cwd apps/rag-api/ingest build && bun run --cwd apps/pi-harness build
scripts.type-check: bun run --cwd apps/chat-api type-check && bun run --cwd apps/controller type-check && bun run --cwd apps/chat-frontend type-check && bun run --cwd apps/rag-api/api type-check && bun run --cwd apps/rag-api/ingest type-check && bun run --cwd apps/pi-harness type-check
